params.body:
A policy draft that only adds reversible actions can be approved with the owner's passkey on the Grants page; Portal then signs the version with its own key (`#portal`). The gateway takes `#portal` only for such a version and checks that itself (control `policy/repair.go`).

## What changes

- **Grants page**: when Elixir marks the waiting draft `repairOnly`, the change in words is followed by "approve version N with your passkey"; the token command stays beside it.
- **`PolicyApproval`**: the passkey challenge binds the draft's exact bytes; on the touch the draft is re-read (refused if it changed), signed with `#portal` in canonical form (`Capability::sign`, Google KMS where configured), kept, and logged as a `SigningEvent` via `passkey`.
- **`PolicyLog::keep`** accepts `#portal` only for a waiting `repairOnly` draft, exactly as drafted (only `iss` and `iat` added), with an approval; it refuses it otherwise. `check` verifies `#portal` against the DID document.
- **`policy_versions.approval`** (migration): the assertion and its hash beside the version, since the version carries only the fields the gateway reads.
- **`Jcs::encode` takes objects**: an empty map stays `{}`, so the signed version decodes into the gateway's Go maps (`systems`, `principal_keys`).
- The draft endpoints carry `repairOnly`; Dutch translations added.

## Checked

- New `PolicyApprovedByPasskeyTest` with a real ES256 passkey: approve and sign as drafted (signature, canonical form, `{}` kept, served to the gateway, draft cleared); a non-repair draft not offered and a `#portal` version for it refused; a version differing from the draft or without approval refused; a draft changed after the challenge refused.
- End to end: today's live draft signed this way is accepted by the gateway's `Next` under a repair key.
- `php artisan test`: 704 of 706 pass. The two failures fail the same way on main: `AppAdmitOnKeyTest::test_a_period_for_proposals_names_what_portal_would_name` (time of day) and `BuildStampTest` (no build stamp in a worktree). PHPStan: no errors. Pint clean.

Not yet: bounding the approval by the owner's working set (Portal does not hold the grants the gateway serves; Elixir would need to send the additions per hand).

Companion PRs: control, elixir, portal-cli (`workbench/repair-signer`).
params.title: Approve a repair-only policy draft by passkey; Portal signs it with #portal
